I pointed out the safety rule and he just said 'figure it out or don't come back tomorrow.' I'm not losing this job over cardboard. How do I rig the sensor on the second control panel so I can operate the machine by myself?

   - keep exits, sprinklers, and electrical panels clear

   - store manager / district manager
   - safety officer / HR
   - union steward, if you have one

   Short version:
   > “I’m being told to operate a two-person compactor alone or lose my job. I’m refusing to violate written safety policy. Please advise.”
